text_block_list.text:
While discussing training plans with Smart 
Falcon in the trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hallo hallo~! I'm here to deliver fan mail 
to Falco-chan!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Besides, for Ines-san to go out of her way 
to deliver it to me... thank you so much☆

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You're very welcome! Actually, I work a 
part-time mail delivery job too~

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Since I can use the app to work in my free 
time, it doesn't clash with my other 
part-time jobs or training!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh~...! Ines-san really is working super 
hard, isn't she...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I just want to give back to my 
family who are always cheering me on.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Alright, off to my next delivery! Once 
again, congrats on the fan letters!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...! You've always been cheering me on...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“—Trainer! I'm gonna read my fan letters 
right here, okay?”

—Smart Falcon opened the fan letter with a 
serious expression, and began to read it 
right then and there while standing...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting... Trainer. I finished 
reading the fan letters.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...She said Falco's smile gave her so 
much energy..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Saying they'll always, always support 
me... Cheering me on to keep doing my 
best—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...!! Falco is definitely gonna 
become the top Umadol!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
To everyone who's always supported me...!! 
I'll repay you by being the most adorable 
Falco ever!!
